requirements.summary: A modern, high-fidelity landing page featuring complex scroll-driven animations, sticky positioning, text reveal effects, and continuous UI mockup animations. The current implementation is very close to the reference, requiring only minor styling and spacing adjustments in the Specialties list.
requirements.template_goal: Refine the existing reusable landing page template by correcting the active state styling and spacing of the scroll-spy Specialties section.
hard_constraints: The active item in the Specialties list must use a light green background (`var(--bg-primary)`) and dark green text (`var(--text-primary)`).
The items in the Specialties list must be tightly spaced vertically (e.g., `gap-2`) with moderate internal padding (e.g., `px-6 py-2`).
All existing animations (Hero loop, text reveal, converging lines, benefits fade-in) must be preserved exactly as they are.
preserve_requirements: The continuous CSS keyframe animation for the Hero UI mockup.
The scroll-driven text reveal logic for the Problem and Solution sections.
The SVG converging lines scroll animation.
The IntersectionObserver logic for the Benefits cards fade-in.
The sticky positioning logic and layout of the Specialties section.
The centralized configuration object (`SITE`) and CSS variables.

section_requirements.name: Sticky Scroll Features (Specialties)
section_requirements.purpose: Highlight supported specialties while keeping core value props visible.
section_requirements.layout: Two-column layout. Left column scrolls, right column is sticky.
must_include: Sticky content area with tag, headline, and stats
styling: Left list items: large text, muted green when inactive. When active, light green background (--bg-primary) with dark green text (--text-primary).
Left list container: tight vertical gap (gap-2).
Left list items padding: moderate horizontal and vertical padding (px-6 py-2).
Right content: tag with light green background, serif headline, large stat numbers
behaviors: Scroll-spy: As the user scrolls down, the active item in the left list changes styling.
Sticky right column: The right side remains fixed in the viewport while the left side scrolls.
Text highlight: The headline on the right highlights specific words sequentially.

layout_requirements: Maintain the existing CSS Grid and Flexbox layouts.
Ensure the Specialties list container uses a tighter vertical gap (`gap-2` instead of `gap-10`).
styling_requirements: Update the `.specialty-item.active` CSS rule to use `background-color: var(--bg-primary);` and `color: var(--text-primary);`.
Update the padding on `.specialty-item` elements to `px-6` and `py-2`.
copy_requirements: Preserve all existing copy driven by the `SITE` configuration object.
asset_requirements: Preserve all existing inline SVGs and icon classes.
behavior_requirements: Preserve all existing scroll and intersection observer behaviors.
animation_requirements: Preserve the Hero continuous loop animation.
Preserve the text reveal progressive highlight animation.
Preserve the converging lines SVG path animation.
Preserve the Benefits cards staggered fade-in.
structure_guidance: Do not rewrite the entire page. Focus only on the targeted CSS and utility class changes in the Specialties section.
execution_plan: 1. Preserve the existing HTML structure, Tailwind config, CSS variables, and JavaScript logic.
2. In the `<style>` block, locate the `.specialty-item.active` CSS rule. Change its `color` property to `var(--text-primary)` and its `background-color` property to `var(--bg-primary)`.
3. Locate the container for the specialty items (e.g., `<div id="specialtyList">` or the element generating the list). Change its gap utility class from `gap-10` to `gap-2`.
4. Locate the individual specialty items (elements with the `specialty-item` class). Update their padding utility classes by changing `px-10` to `px-6` and `py-3` to `py-2`.
5. Verify that the rest of the page remains untouched and functions exactly as before.
known_unknowns: The exact HTML structure of the truncated Specialties section is inferred, but the required utility class changes are clear.

interaction_checkpoints.name: Specialties Scroll Active State
interaction_checkpoints.trigger: Scroll down past hero into the Specialties section
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: The active list item on the left gets a light green background and dark green text, and the items are spaced closely together.

acceptance_criteria: The active item in the Specialties list has a light green background and dark green text.
The items in the Specialties list have reduced vertical spacing and padding compared to the previous iteration.
All other animations and layouts on the page continue to function correctly.
